In 2017, DOSS started with a belief: every student has potential, but not everyone gets the chance to discover it.💙

That belief became a community. A place where students learn by doing, take responsibility, face real challenges, and discover that they’re capable of more than they thought.

Since then, we’ve reached 5,000+ students and held 30+ events and workshops. But our story was never just about numbers or events. It’s about developing people who are willing to learn, take initiative, and create change around them.

At DOSS, we don’t expect you to have it all figured out. You just need to be willing to start, grow, and make a difference.

And as each generation passes the responsibility to the next, one thing stays the same: our belief in the potential of students to become the people who create change.

We started in 2017. We’re still learning, still growing, and still creating change — together.

This is DOSS. And this is only part of our story. 🧡

latestPosts.caption:
The goal is never to follow a trend simply because it is popular. It is to create a design that reflects a way of living, evokes a sense of belonging, and grows more beautiful with time—long after fleeting styles have passed.

Because true luxury is not about adding more. It is about knowing what deserves to remain, what can be left unsaid, and how to make every element feel perfectly in place.

🎙️✨ ضيفة مميزة في حلقة  من **كواليس الهندسة**!

يشرفنا  وجود **Marry Michelle**، الـ Architect والـ Interior Designer، معانا في حلقة جديدة هنتكلم فيها عن عالم العمارة والتصميم من زاوية مختلفة 🖤

استنونا قريبًا… كواليس جديدة وحكايات تستحق تتسمع! 🔥

#كواليس_الهندسة #MarryMichelle #Architecture #InteriorDesign #Podcast ComingSoon

Kitchen colors trendy 2027..✨
SAVE THESE BEFORE YOUR NEXT KITCHEN PROJECT

What makes a house feel like home?

It’s never just the furniture, the finishes, or the way a space looks.
It’s the feeling you get the moment you walk through the door.

The comfort.
The warmth.
The little details that feel unmistakably yours.

Because true luxury isn’t simply about creating a beautiful space.
#interiors #interiordesign #homedesign #luxury

Floor-to-ceiling windows blur the line between indoors and nature, allowing natural light to become part of the design language. Every element has a purpose, every material tells a story, and every corner is designed to slow life down for just a moment.

“A luxury home is more than a beautiful space.

It’s the feeling of coming home and instantly feeling at ease.

A place that gives you space to breathe,
to slow down,
and to live with ease.

A perfect home isn’t about having more…
it’s about living better.

From the sculptural marble vanity to the warm ambient lighting, every element was designed to create an experience—not just a space.
#bathroom #interiors #interiordesign #homedecor #architecture

Luxury isn’t about having more.
It’s about choosing every detail with intention.

The materials.
The textures.
The lighting.
The way a space makes you feel.

Because true luxury doesn’t need to be loud —
you simply feel it.

Some spaces don’t need bold colors or dramatic details to make a statement.
They speak through texture, light, proportion, and silence.

وَبَشِّرِ الصَّابِرِينَ ۝ الَّذِينَ إِذَا أَصَابَتْهُمْ مُصِيبَةٌ قَالُوا إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ ۝ أُوْلَئِكَ عَلَيْهِمْ صَلَوَاتٌ مِنْ رَبِّهِمْ وَرَحْمَةٌ وَأُوْلَئِكَ هُمُ الْمُهْتَدُونَ
.
اللهم بأسمك الرحيم، أرحم روحه.
اللهم بأسمك الغفار، أغفر له وسامحه.
اللهم بأسمك الفتاح، افتح له أبواب الجنة.
اللهم بأسمك الرافع، ارفعه بين عبادك يوم القيامة.
اللهم بأسمك اللطيف، الطف به في وحدته.
اللهم بأسمك الواسع، وسع له مدخله.
اللهم بأسمك العفو، اعفُ عن أخطاءه وزلاته.
.
ربي، إنه كان من الصابرين على البلاء، فاجزه خيرًا. وكان من المحسنين، فتقبل منه إحسانه.وكان من اللطيفين المبتسمين، فأجعل كل ذلك في ميزان حسناته.
اللهم إنه كان مسلمآ موحدًا بك، مؤمنًا برسولك الكريم وبسائر أنبيائك، فثبته عند السؤال، وأرفع درجته في المهديين، وأجعل إيمانه وإسلامه وعمله الصالح نورًا وشفيعًا له برحمتك يا أرحم الراحمين.
اللهم آنس وحشته، وأرحم غربته، ونور قبره، ووسع مدخله، وأجعل قبره روضةً من رياض الجنة، ولا تجعله حفرةً من حفر النار.
اللهم أغفر له وارحمه، وعافه واعف عنه، وأكرم نزله، ووسّع مدخله، وأغسله بالماء والثلج والبرد، ونقّه من الخطايا كما نقّيت الثوب الأبيض من الدنس.
اللهم أجعل ما أصابه من صبر وبلاء كفارة له ورفعة في درجاته، وأجمعنا به في جناتك جنات النعيم، برحمتك يا أرحم الراحمين.
وصل اللهم وسلم وبارك على سيدنا ونبينا محمد، وعلى آله وأصحابه، ومن اتبع سنته وهديه إلى يوم الدين أجمعين.

Grateful…
for creating a life that always brings me back to myself.

العيلة مش معناها إن كل يوم فيها سهل…

ولا إن مافيش خلافات، ولا وجع، ولا أيام بنبعد فيها عن بعض.

إحنا عدينا بحاجات كتير، واتكسرنا، واتشدينا، واختلفنا، وبعدين رجعنا تاني.

بس كل مرة كنت باكتشف إن الأصل عمره ما بيروح.

في الآخر…

Alexandria wasn’t just a city.
It was where I ran when Cairo got too loud…
where my father once lived,
and where I learned what “safe” felt like.

I loved there.
I broke there.
I took people there who became memories…
and left pieces of me on that shore.

But somehow…
every time I go back,
it takes me in again.

The sea doesn’t ask questions.
The streets don’t hold grudges.
The same boats, the same fishermen,
the same quiet cafés…
like nothing ever broke.

From my father…
to my friends…
to every version of me that passed through it—

Alexandria stayed.

And I keep falling for it,
again and again.

latestIgtvVideos.caption: The Grand Night is an Egyptian animated feature film produced by @giraffics.studio . The film has been selected for the Annecy MIFA pitches in 2020 round. “The Grand Night," English for “El Leila El Kebira,” is the original name of a famous Egyptian operetta that was created in the 60's. It portrays the atmosphere of “El-Moulid,” a traditional folkloric festival in which Egyptian families gather to chant songs, watch shows, play games, enjoy street food and more. With modernized features, relatable struggles and an original plot, the movie revives the popular characters and songs of the operetta, along with other folkloric figures in the Egyptian culture. The film is expected to be released by the end of 2022. 🍿

Today, we celebrate a milestone!

Cairo Spots turns 10 years old, and we’re marking this special occasion with something extraordinary – our brand new app is now available on the App Store! 

For a decade, we’ve been your guide to everything happening in Egypt, from entertainment to movies, from the latest venues to the hottest events. And now, we’re bringing you a whole new experience to discover it all. This is Egypt, reimagined.

Our new app isn’t just an update; it’s a fresh, immersive way to stay connected with the city’s vibrant scene. With a design as bold and iconic as Cairo itself, this app is here to transform how you explore, experience, and enjoy Egypt.

Today, we’re celebrating the past, the present, and the exciting road ahead. Join us on this journey – download the Cairo Spots app, and let’s keep making memories together.

Welcome to the next chapter of Cairo Spots. Available now on the App Store.

Introducing Egypt Events Calendar. A live, constantly updated calendar built to reflect everything happening around you, 24/7.

From major ticketed concerts and global festivals to intimate café events, community gatherings, workshops, exhibitions, and pop ups. If it’s happening, it belongs here. No matter the scale, no matter where it was announced.

The calendar is carefully categorized and thoughtfully filtered, so you can search by city, venue, artist, category, timing, ticketing, or pricing and find exactly what you’re looking for without the noise. Multiple calendar views let you explore events your way, whether you like to plan by week, browse visually, or scan by map.

Our mission has always been simple. To connect you with what’s happening around you. To help you discover your vibe, your favorite venues, and new experiences you might not have found otherwise. And through that, maybe meet new people, reconnect with the city, and find more joy in everyday life.

This calendar is an extension of everything we do. One more tool to help you decide how you want to spend your time.

Explore Egypt Events Calendar now on cairospots.com.

Follow @cairospots, visit cairospots.com, and download our Cairo Spots iOS app for everything happening across the city.

We’re looking for passionate, curious and ambitious individuals to join our growing teams across journalism, digital publishing, creative production, business development and technology.

Our opportunities are open to experienced professionals, junior candidates, fresh graduates and students seeking internships. We welcome fresh perspectives, original ideas and individuals who are eager to learn, contribute and grow with us.

Arrow officially introduced itself to the watersports scene at Makani Beach Club in El Gouna. 

The launch brought together local riders and professional athletes for a two day event centered on the sport.  

The weekend included a Highest Jump challenge with 60 participants testing Arrow gear, alongside a Big Air competition. 

International tracking platform WOO Sports also selected the event to test its newest global technology live on the water.  

Founded by Seif El Sheshtawy, Arrow aims to put Egyptian kiteboarding on the global map while developing new products and hosting future regional competitions.  

Follow @cairospots, visit cairospots.com, or download the Cairo Spots app on iOS for more.

Egyptian artist Wegz confirmed the drop of “Aqarib Deluxe,” bringing fresh material to streaming platforms. 

The announcement follows his original “Aqarib” album release, promising new tracks and updated sounds for listeners.

The deluxe edition drops tomorrow at 6 PM Cairo time across major digital streaming networks.

Follow @cairospots, visit cairospots.com, or download the Cairo Spots app on iOS for more.

@thespotsstudio : Hussein Fahmy joined film professionals at the CineGouna Forum to discuss how legendary Egyptian director Mohamed Khan reshaped lead male roles in Egyptian cinema.

The panel, titled “The Unlikely Hero: Men in the Cinema of Mohamed Khan,” was moderated by film critic Ramy Abdel Razek. Speakers included actor Hussein Fahmy, director Nadine Khan, film critic Ahmed Shawky, and actor Ahmed Dawood.

During the discussion, Hussein Fahmy highlighted Khan’s signature approach to character development, noting that Khan consistently gravitated toward flawed, non-traditional underdogs rather than typical heroic tropes. The session detailed how Khan challenged conventional portrayals of masculinity on screen, grounding his characters in the real social and economic realities of their times.  

Follow @cairospots, visit cairospots.com, or download the Cairo Spots app on iOS for more.

Egyptian actress Tara Emad has officially signed on for a leading role in Universal Pictures’ upcoming feature The Mummy: Book of the Dead.

The new installment brings back original franchise stars Brendan Fraser and Rachel Weisz as Rick and Evelyn O’Connell, along with John Hannah, Oded Fehr, and Kevin J. O’Connor. Directing duties are handled by Radio Silence filmmaking duo Matt Bettinelli-Olpin and Tyler Gillett (Scream, Ready or Not), working from a script written by David Coggeshall.

While specific plot points and Emad’s exact character details are currently being kept quiet, production is underway ahead of the film’s scheduled theatrical release on October 15, 2027.

Follow @cairospots, visit cairospots.com, or download the Cairo Spots app on iOS for more.

Breadfast Coffee has officially rolled out a new campaign celebrating the different ways Egyptians enjoy their daily brew. 

Marking five years in the local market, the campaign highlights the brand’s goal of bringing specialty coffee, premium beverages, and food to a wider audience.

Through a lighthearted look at personal coffee habits, the campaign focuses on variety and accessibility. 

Breadfast Coffee currently serves customers across more than 50 locations nationwide, while also offering fast delivery through the main Breadfast mobile app. 

The full campaign is now live across the brand’s digital platforms.

Follow @cairospots, visit cairospots.com, or download the Cairo Spots app on iOS for more.

Egyptian producer Nourey has built an extraordinary path from picking up a guitar at ten to performing on global stages for Above & Beyond’s Anjunabeats. 

First landing on the label’s radar through dorm-room livestreams during lockdown, she has since performed at major festival milestones including ABGT600 and ABGT700.

When she isn’t producing progressive house and trance tracks, Nourey conducts climate research at MIT, heading a live-music carbon footprint project backed by Coldplay and Live Nation.

Follow @cairospots, visit cairospots.com, or download the Cairo Spots app on iOS for more.

@thespotsstudio : Egyptian cinema icon Youssra joined director Karim El Shennawy, Abdulla Al Nuaimi, and Majed Al Mansoori at the CineGouna Forum for a panel on the role of Arabic in film.  

Moderated by Zena AbdelBaky, the session titled “The Future Speaks Arabic” focused on how cinema protects cultural identity and creates opportunities for emerging creators. During the discussion, Youssra emphasized the responsibility of passing down heritage and culture through screen storytelling.  

The panel explored practical ways cultural institutions and regional festivals can open doors for new voices across the Arab world.  

Follow @cairospots, visit cairospots.com, or download the Cairo Spots app on iOS for more.

Mayan El-Sayed has teamed up with Copa Açaí to introduce a new signature beverage.  

The drink features a blend of passion fruit, peaches, strawberry, coconut water, and coconut cream, alongside Ole Nutrients collagen.  

The concept behind the recipe draws inspiration from sunsets, personal growth, and taking time for self-care.  
The new beverage is now available at all Copa Açaí branches and for delivery.

With the start of a new academic year, 99% of burn survivors have dropped out of education due to the constant bullying they face in schools from the people around them on daily basis.
It is crucial to prepare children psychologically and behaviorally to deal with any difference they may encounter, which also includes supporting burn survivors who are facing several struggles on their own, starting with their physiological pain to trying to accept their scars. 
Friends and close circles need to make sure that the survivors feel accepted and help them smoothly pass through this difficult stage, consequently, neither bullying nor rejection from society will shape their lives and negatively affect their future.

latestIgtvVideos.title: Happy SMA Awareness Month!♿️
latestIgtvVideos.caption:
It’s August! Which means it’s SMA awareness month! SMA awareness month was created by organizations and parents who describe SMA as a “disease”. It’s time for that to change! This SMA awareness month is about celebrating, respecting, and listening to people with SMA. We don’t need you to be aware that our particular condition exists; we need you to believe in us, value us, and that begins by seeing us as extraordinary people instead of a medical condition. I dedicate this video to all the parents with SMA kids and all the people with SMA, keep fighting and keep shining because you’re born to stand out! I’m a content creator with SMA, I am proud of who I am and you should too!👩🏻‍🦼🤍

latestIgtvVideos.title: High School Graduation 2020 👩🏻‍🎓
latestIgtvVideos.caption:
Graduating high school isn’t easy, on the contrary, it’s freaking terrifying. Saying goodbye to your second home and the second family that you’ve spent almost 14 years together and most of your childhood with, everyone going onto their own path of life and moving on. All this isn’t easy and if I could go back to a time where things were simpler and would spend more time with my friends, I wouldn’t think twice and would go back but as they say, everything has an end but this isn’t just goodbye as it’s a hello to a whole new beginning! We haven't realized that it would be this hard to let it go, to face something new.  14 years ago, most of us were three years old crying their eyes out while entering the school premises for the first time and here we are now, 14 years later, crying 18 years old walking out for the last time. 

Fellow Conti Graduates, always aim high, work hard, and care deeply about what you believe in! Now go, and make interesting mistakes, make amazing mistakes, make glorious and fantastic mistakes. Break rules. Leave the world more interesting for you being here. Make good art. Thank you for all the good times and sticking around together since forever. This isn’t goodbye and till we meet again! @contiseniors20 

To all the family and friends who attended the ceremony, thank you for always being there for us and we couldn’t have made it without your constant support, encouragement and love. We love you so much & we owe it to you all! @jessy_elabd @haitham.hassan39 @nevine.ezzeldin @keelabd @mariammelabdd @mohameddhaitham @nwaleedd @janaelrehewy @youssufalkassry @annelshaal @ezzlelabd 

To our second home, principal Mrs Saneya and  the whole Continental family, thank you for helping us rise and shape us into who we are today, we owe it to all of you & thank you for teaching us what a true family is!

Here’s to new beginnings & goodbye high school!👩🏻‍🎓💜

3 things to avoid doing with people with disabilities

Awareness starts with the little things.
Don’t assume. Don’t use our spaces. Don’t help out of feeling guilty.

People with disabilities deserve respect, independence, and to be treated like everyone else.

Which one do you think people need to hear the most?♿️

ماتفترضش. ومتخدوش الأماكن المخصصة لينا. و مفيش مساعدة بتتعمل ب مشاعر ذنب.

الأشخاص ذوي الإعاقة محتاجين احترام واستقلالية، مش شفقة.

#peoplewithdisability #disabilityrights #awareness #pwd #ذوي_الاحتياجات_الخاصة

🌟 August is SMA Awareness Month! 🌟

Hey, I’m Nadia! 💕 Excited to be collaborating with What Women Want Magazine @whatwomenwantmag to spread awareness all month about Spinal Muscular Atrophy. Living with SMA has never held me back. I believe in spreading hope and positivity, reminding everyone that differences make us stronger together. 🤝 Let’s raise awareness about SMA and build a supportive community that embraces everyone, regardless of their abilities. 🌈💪

El Alsson Shark Tank

Male Mental Health & Toxic Masculinity 

Majd Bahour is a psychotherapist who is currently licensed in the United Kingdom along with many other countries. She has experience in working with a variety of mental health disorders such as anxiety, depression, anger-management, ADHD, bullying, cyber-bullying, sexual assault, post-traumatic stress disorder, domestic violence, self-harm, suicidal ideation, mood disorders, panic attacks, grief and bereavement, relationship issues, attachment issues, family issues, and addiction.  She earned her Master's of Science degree in Psychological Therapies from Queen Mary University of London and is currently a member of the British Psychological Association. In addition, she has been in training with the Beck Institute for Cognitive Behavioural Therapy and I have completed multiple safeguarding trainings as well as trainings in several therapy approaches such as problem-focused therapy, group therapy, family therapy, schema-focused therapy, solution-focused therapy, and mentalisation-based treatment . In addition, she hosts workshops that promote mental well-being in different universities around London. 
In this talk our High School Counselor, Nadine Arafa spoke with Majd about defining Toxic Masculinity and what it entails, how holding certain ideas and beliefs can negatively impact one’s capacity to have healthy flourishing relationships with others in addition to how they experience their own emotional processes. They also spoke about what we can collectively put in place to foster functional emotional expression.

We are delighted to announce the launch of Alsson El Kheir, El Alsson NewGiza’s charitable initiative! Alsson El Kheir aims to nurture a spirit of giving within our school community and make a meaningful impact on the lives of those in need throughout the year.

This season, we have an exciting calendar of activities lined up, designed to engage our students, parents, and staff in acts of kindness and community support. Our key projects include:

Winter Clothes Drive – Collecting and distributing warm clothing to families in need during the winter season.
Ramadan: The Month of Giving – Preparing and distributing 500+ Ramadan boxes to school workers, orphanages, and families in need, and hosting Fun Days and Iftar gatherings for children.
Eid El-Fitr Givings – Sharing joy and gifts with orphanages and families in need.
Workers’ Appreciation – Celebrating and recognizing the dedication of our school workers.
Eid Al-Adha Givings – Providing essential goods to families and orphanages.
School Supplies Donation Drive – Supporting children’s education by donating school materials to orphanages and families in need.
We warmly invite you to join us in these meaningful initiatives, helping to instill compassion and generosity in our students while making a real difference in our community.

Together, we can turn small acts of kindness into lasting impact. Stay tuned for updates and ways to get involved!

Today, our Grade 12 students had the privilege of welcoming Dalia Wahba, CEO of Hassan Allam Utilities, as part of our Alsson Talks series! 

Recognized by Forbes Middle East as one of the region’s 100 Most Powerful Businesswomen, Dalia shared her professional journey and insights from the world of business, investment, and leadership.

Through Alsson Talks, we bring influential voices and inspiring journeys to our students, opening doors to new perspectives and helping them envision the possibilities that lie ahead.

A valuable opportunity for our seniors to learn from a leader making an impact and to be inspired as they take their own next steps toward the future!

Through hands-on investigation, our students are building the essential practical and analytical skills needed for success in IB Chemistry!

💛🧁 Kindness brings us together — and sometimes, takes us back in time!

Our Wellness Ambassadors invited the entire MHS community to vote for the kindest student, celebrating those who make our school a warmer place through their compassion and thoughtful gestures.

The sweetest surprise? Bringing back the nostalgic Kindness Cupcakes tradition from El Alsson Elementary School in Haraneya! A beautiful piece of our school's history came to life once again, spreading smiles and reminding us that the smallest acts of kindness can leave the biggest impact.

A heartfelt thank you to our Wellness Ambassadors for keeping this lovely tradition alive. Here's to celebrating kindness, one cupcake at a time! 💛

Yesterday afternoon, the Primary Small Hall was filled with conversation, curiosity, and coffee as we welcomed Year 8 families to our IGCSE Information Coffee Evening.
It was a genuine pleasure to share an open and honest overview of the IGCSE journey, from the structure and philosophy of the programme to how the three-year pathway beginning in Year 9 supports our students both academically and personally. Parents also heard about how we continue to refine the programme, including our approach to modular and linear courses, and how we support students’ wellbeing as they step into this exciting new phase.
Thank you to every parent who joined us and contributed so openly. Your trust and support mean a great deal, and we are excited to walk alongside your children as they begin their IGCSE journey with confidence.

عايز أشارك معاكم حاجة جديدة 💚

أكيد كل واحد فينا عنده حاجات كتير في البيت مركونة ومش بيستخدمها… لبس بقاله سنتين أو تلاتة ماتلبسش، جزم، شنط، أجهزة، أو حتى ديكور في البيت بقاله سنين على الرف.

طب ليه الحاجات دي تفضل مركونة، مع إنها ممكن تكون بالظبط الحاجة اللي حد تاني بيدور عليها ومحتاجها؟

والأحلى بقى إن الشخص ده ممكن يكون عنده هو كمان حاجة إنت محتاجها جدًا، بس هو مش بيستخدمها! 

ومن هنا جاتلي فكرة LOOP — خد وهات 🔄

الفكرة ببساطة إننا عملنا ويب سايت نقدر من خلاله نعرض الحاجات اللي مش محتاجينها، ونبدّلها بحاجات تانية ممكن تكون مفيدة لينا.

يعني إنت بتعرض الحاجة اللي عندك، وتشوف الحاجات اللي الناس عارضاها، ولو لقيت حاجة محتاجها، تقدر تتواصل مباشرة مع صاحبها، وتعرض عليه التبديل، وتتفقوا مع بعض.

من غير بيع ولا شراء ولا فلوس. مجرد تبادل بين اتنين كل واحد فيهم عنده حاجة التاني محتاجها.

 بقالي فترة شغال على الفكرة دي، ودلوقتي حابب أشاركها معاكم، ونبدأ التجربة دي سوا.

latestPosts.caption:
October takes us from Cairo to the mountains of Saint Catherine. 
Share and tag along with your friends. 

Join us for The Long Way In, a three-day retreat of hiking, inspirational talks and inner work. Only two spots remain; DM us “Catherine” to book.

Back in Wadi Degla, Fosha brings an easy hike, games and good company on Saturday, October 17. Come along at 4:30 PM; no registration is needed, and gate fees apply.

Then, on Friday, October 23, HWS Originals returns with guest speaker Reem Khater for The Stories We Wear. Meet us at Wadi Degla’s Main Gate at 4:30 PM. No registration needed; gate fees apply.

Swipe through for the details. We’d love to see you out there.
#HikewithSherief #fromcouchtowadi

⁨	⁨	٣ أيام مع مريم نعوم في قلب الصعيد… وإنتوا جزء من الحكاية.

حكاياتنا اللي بنعيشها | HWS SPECIALS

في حكايات بنلاقي فيها نفسنا، وشخصيات بنحس إننا عارفينها… وأسئلة نفسنا نقعد وناخد وقتنا فيه.

وده اللي بتجمعنا عليه رحلة ‪‪@hikewithsherief‬‬ للمنيا، مع ضيفة الشرف الكاتبة مريم نعوم: قعدات وحوارات على مهل، نقرّب فيها من الجانب الإنساني لمريم وللحكايات اللي بتكتبها، ونفتح مساحة لأسئلتكم ووجهات نظركم

إنتوا جزء من الحوار، وأي حكي عن تجاربكم الشخصية دايمًا باختياركم.

وبين القعدات، مشي خفيف وسط أماكن المنيا الثقافية والتراثية، ووقت للقراية والراحة والأكل سوا، وإقامة في نيو هرموبوليس… مع مجموعة صغيرة، فيها فرصة نتعرف ونسمع بعض بجد.

الرحلة والحوارات بقيادة شريف العبد، وبمشاركة آية دوا‪@ayahdowara‬ra‬ra في توجيه الحوارات.

مشي وحوار عن صورتنا عن نفسنا، وثقتنا، وإزاي بنعبّر عن نفسنا باختياراتنا ولبسنا.

The Long Way In is our Saint Catherine Special Edition. A “Retreat” that combines hiking, summiting Mount Katrina and inner work through inspirational talks, group reflective conversations and personal stories. 
If you’re a high achiever wanting to truly disconnect, DM us for the details. This experience is yours!

Thank you to our official outdoor experience partner @hikewithsherief for being part of the 8th edition of MedFest Egypt.
Your support and collaboration helped bring Beyond the Scene to life. We’re grateful for your trust, contribution, and for being part of this journey.
شكراً لhike with sherief على كونهم جزء من النسخة الثامنة من مهرجان ميدفيست مصر
دعمكم وتعاونكم كانوا جزءًا أساسيًا من نجاح برّه المشهد، وسعداء
بوجودكم ومساهمتكم في الرحلة دي.
#MFE8

⁨	ابعت الصور دي لصاحبك اللي قالك «عايزني اروح اعمل هايكينج 😅؟»… وقوله: أهو. 🌅

آه، الناس دي كانت هناك فعلًا… وإنت غالبًا كنت بتقلّب في الموبايل وبتقول «مفيش حاجة تتعمل».

شوية مشي، شوية لعب، وناس أول مرة تتقابل… وفجأة بقى عندهم صور وذكريات مع بعض.

الصور حلوة؟ تخيّل بقى لو إنت فيها.

لمّ الشلّة، وتابعنا عشان تعرف فسحتنا الجاية إمتى.
ومش لازم تستنى حد ييجي معاك… تعالى لوحدك، وانتا ترجع بصحاب إد اللي عندك.

فُسْحَة. الجدّ يستنّى.⁩

آخر مرة سمعت نفسك… كانت إمتى؟

في سانت كاترين، هنمشي وسط الجبال، نقابل أهل المكان، ونسيب وقت للحكايات اللي تستاهل تتسمع.

وفي The Long Way In، فيه كمان كلام عن الخوف والقرارات وإمتى نكمّل، من تجارب شريف في الجبال ورياضات التحمّل وشغله كمستشار عالمي.

وبعد الكلام، نقعد نفكّر سوا… وبعدين كل واحد ياخد وقته مع كشكوله وأفكاره. تحب تشارك؟ أهلاً. تحب تكتب لنفسك؟ براحتك.

15–17 October 2026
سانت كاترين — مش مجرد طلعة جبل.

عايز تعرف البرنامج والإقامة والمشي والتكلفة؟ ابعتلنا «كاترين» في الـDM ونبعتلك البروشور.

#HikeWithSherief #HWSSpecials

ابعت البوست لجروب «لازم نتقابل قريب»… الجمعة دي عندنا خطة 😉

أول فُسْحَة by @hikewithsherief يوم الجمعة ٢٥ سبتمبر: مشي، لعب، ضحك ودردشة مع بعض. لمّ صحابك وتعالوا، وكل التفاصيل في الصور الجاية.

📍 محمية وادي دجلة — زهراء المعادي
الجدّ يستنّى. 😉

حوالي ٢٫٥ كم مشي، ألعاب وضحك، ودردشة مفتوحة حوالي نص ساعة… والمتكلمين المرة دي إنتوا! 😏

هنتحرك ونتكلم ونلعب مع بعض. وهانشوف صاحبك اللي بيقول «أنا مش تنافسي» هيعمل إيه أول ما اللعب يبدأ 😀

مستنيينكم الجمعة ٢٥ سبتمبر في فُسْحَة by Hike with Sherief.
📍 محمية وادي دجلة — زهراء المعادي

المعاد الوحيد اللي ناخده بجد… وبعدها الجدّ يستنّى 😉

📍 محمية وادي دجلة — زهراء المعادي، عند البوابة الرئيسية
🗓 الجمعة ٢٥ سبتمبر
التجمع ٤:٤٥ م — نبدأ ٥:٠٠ م بالظبط
هنخلص حوالي ٩ بالليل.

هات معاك ١ لتر ماية على الأقل، احسب وقت الطريق ودخول المحمية، وتعالى بدري عشان نبدأ سوا. ابعت الصورة لصحابك عشان تبقوا متفقين على المكان والمعاد.

أيوه، كل أنشطة فُسْحَة مقدّمة مجانًا من فريق @hikewithsherief 

اللي هتدفعه بس هو تذكرة دخول المحمية:
• ١٠٠ جنيه للمصريين
• ٢٥٠ جنيه للأجانب

التذكرة بتتدفع للمحمية مباشرة، مش لينا. فريق HWS ما بيحصّلش رسوم مشاركة في الفُسْحَة ولا رسوم دخول المحمية.

ماتنساش تجيب معاك ١ لتر ماية واية حاجة تأكلوها علشان احنا مابنقدمش اكل

«أسجّل فين؟ أبعتلكم إني جاي؟»
ولا أي حاجة… تعالى على طول 👌

مفيش تسجيل، مفيش حجز، ومش محتاج تبعتلنا أو تقولنا إنك جاي. هات إزازة ميّه، لمّ صحابك، وكون عند البوابة الرئيسية الساعة ٤:٤٥ م يوم الجمعة ٢٥ سبتمبر.

البرنامج من ١٦ سنة وطالع، والأطفال ينورونا في المشي مع أهلهم. عرب وأجانب، بتتكلم عربي أو إنجليزي… كله ينورنا!

Arabic & English speakers welcome. No booking. No DMs. Just show up.

Mercy for every civilian who lost his life, and hope is on a day when pain ends and safety returns to everyone.

latestPosts.caption:
لو الـAI اختفى بكرة… هتعرف تكمل يومك؟
الـAI ممكن يساعدنا نعمل حاجات ماكناش نتخيلها… والفيلم ده نفسه ماكانش ممكن يتعمل بالشكل ده، بالتكلفة دي وفي الوقت ده، من غيره.
لكن إيه اللي ممكن يحصل لو بطلنا نتعلم، وسيبنا حياتنا كلها ماشية على الـauto pilot؟ من أكبر قرار في حياتنا، لحد أبسط رد على إيميل… أو تلخيص رسالة من أربع سطور.
٢٠٧٩: السؤال الأخير. تكملة الفيلم القصير «٢٠٧٩»، بطولة @ashraf.serag.ai (ممثل افتراضي).
تنفيذ وإخراج: حازم أبو الوفا

لينك الجزء الأول «٢٠٧٩» في البروفايل، ولينك الفيلم ده بأعلى جودة على YouTube، موجود في البايو.
اتفرجوا للآخر… لأن آخر سؤال بيغيّر كل حاجة.
الفكرة والسكريبت شغل بشري، وبعض مشاهد الـAI اتطورت بدمج الـ3D والـVFX في الـpost-production.
#٢٠٧٩ #السؤال_الأخير

الفيلم خيالي، ولا يمت للواقع بصلة، ومش تنبؤ بالمستقبل.

بعد ١٥ سنة في الـ 3D و الـ VFX…
وسنة تجارب مع الـ AI
قررت أمزج بين الـ AI وبين خبرتي في السرد والإخراج.
الفيلم بروح مصرية… بيرجعنا لتفاصيل الحياة زمان: البساطة، الألوان، والذكريات.
وفي نفس الوقت بيناقش إزاي كل واحد فينا ممكن يشوف نفس المشهد بشكل مختلف.
#xmotionstudio #aiart #ai #vfx

2079 – فيلم قصير بالذكاء الاصطناعي

ملحوظة مهمة:
المشاهد دي مش مخرجات خام من موديل واحد،
تم دمجها مع شغل 3D و VFX ومعالجة في الـ Post Production عشان تتظبط ويتعالج أغلب مشاكل التوليد.

مافيش كاميرات صوّرت المشاهد دي.
كل الشخصيات خيالية.
حتى صوت الراجل العجوز متصمّم بالكامل بالـ AI.
والموسيقى كمان تم تعديلها بالذكاء الاصطناعي، اتضافت آلات زي الكمان واتغيّرت أجزاء عشان تمشي مع الإيقاع الدرامي.

ده مش Seedance 2.0.
استخدمت أكتر من موديل زي:
Kling 2.1 / 2.5 / 3.0
Wan 2.6

هل دمج الـ AI مع الـ 3D والـ VFX ممكن يطلع شكل مختلف ومقبول سينمائيًا؟

لينك النسخة الكاملة بجودة عالية على يوتيوب في البايو.

العمل خيالي بالكامل ولا يمت للواقع بصلة.
#xmotionstudio #aiart

بما إن فيه جزء جديد تكملة لفيلم «٢٠٧٩» 🎬 قريب، وبما إن الراجل العجوز له شخصيته وصوته المميز وطريقته وتعبيراته الخاصة، قررت أدي للبطل اسم.

أحب أعرفكم بـ @ashraf.serag.ai
أول ممثل مصري بالذكاء الاصطناعي تابعوا صفحته، ولو عندكم أي سؤال ليه، اسألوه هناك وهو هيرد عليكم بنفسه.
#ai #aiactor

عادةً في فيديوهات ال AI، بفضّل أعمل كل شوت لوحده، عشان أتحكم أكتر في الكادر، الشخصيات وحركة الكاميرا. غالبًا ده راجع لطريقة شغلي بالـ3D خلال السنين اللي فاتت.

لكن المرة دي حبيت أختبر العكس: هل Prompt واحد يقدر يعمل فيديو من كذا شوت، ويحافظ على المنتج والشخصيات، ويتعامل مع الانتقالات بشكل مقنع؟

استخدمت مرجع للcan، ومرجع للشخصيات، وPrompt واحد على Seedance 2.5 بدقة 720p، ومن غير تقريبًا أي post-production أو color grading على غير العادة.

دي تجربة شخصية ومش إعلان رسمي لV 7. اخترت الـPink Lemonade لأني بحبه فعلًا.

وده الناتج... أنا شخصياً لو هنفّذه كشغل نهائي، برضه هفضّل أعمله شوت شوت عشان أفضل متحكم في كل تفصيلة.
#xmotionstudio

لما اللي جنبك يبقى متابع الرسالة أكتر منك 😂
Created with AI tools for Galaxy AI Lab.
#galaxyaicompetition
#galaxyailab

I am the one who bakes 😎

Made with Kling 3.0, Blender, Substance Painter & After Effects.

P.S. The kahk 3D scene was from our Eid greeting video last year. I thought, why not mix it with AI?

2079 | AI Short Film 🎬

I’ve just released the English version of my short film 2079. 

The film explores a future where humanity becomes completely dependent on AI.

This is not raw AI output. The project combines AI-generated visuals with VFX and post-production to shape the final result. I mostly used Kling 3.0 and wan 2.6 for video generation.

The story is purely fictional and not intended to predict or represent real events.

High-quality YouTube link in bio.

#aifilm #aishortfilm #artificialintelligence

٢٠٧٩ — الإعلان التشويقي | فيلم قصير بالذكاء الاصطناعي

في وقت بقى فيه أغلب المحتوى بالذكاء الاصطناعي مجرد تجارب ومقارنات بين AI models…
قررت أتعامل معاه كأداة سينما مش Benchmark.

هل يقدر الذكاء الاصطناعي يترجم الخيال لفيديو حقيقي بإحساس وصورة مقبولة سينمائيًا؟

حبيت أجرب وأشوف إيه اللي ممكن يحصل لو دمجنا الـ AI مع المؤثرات البصرية (VFX) والـ 3D في الPost production.

الفيلم القصير... قريبًا جدًا.

لينك Youtube بجودة أعلى أول كومنت.

CASE, TARS… meet Karim 😄

Interstellar reimagined with @karimabdelazizofficial in the cockpit!

A quick experiment using AI.
اللون... فيلم قصير بالذكاء الاصطناعي.

بقالي شوية بجرب WAN 2.2 Animate،
وجربت أبدّل نفسي في كذا مشهد بإضاءة مختلفة تمامًا علشان أشوف هيقدر يتعامل إزاي مع الظلال وتضاريس الوش.

المفاجأة إنه قدر يتأقلم مع مصادر الإضاءة المتحركة ويعمل ظلال واقعية جدًا.
لهب الشمعة والدخان شكلهم و حركتهم طبيعي جدًا.
حتى القماش بيتحرك بطريقة طبيعية، والكسرات بتتفاعل مع حركة الجسم بشكل دقيق.

بس لما أعاد تكويني… 😅 شكلي طلع مختلف شوية! (استخدمت Seedream 4 لتغيير المشهد).

وبصراحة، كحد شغال في مجال 3D وVFX، الموضوع ده مبهر جدًا بالنسبة لي.
#xmotionstudio #aiart #comfyui

latestPosts.caption:
From Dior’s phone accessory to Pringles offering 200 years of free chips in exchange for an unusual burial deal, brands had some wild ideas this week.

Here are the top marketing, business and brand stories you might have missed.

#MarketingMentor

France’s cost-of-living protests turned violent on October 17, with masked groups targeting major retailers, including Apple, Louis Vuitton and Hermès.

Stores across cities such as Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille and Lille were reportedly looted, while businesses and public buildings suffered damage.

The unrest also saw fires and clashes with police, prompting a major response from authorities. Reports said arrests rose to around 1,200 by late evening.

French President Emmanuel Macron condemned the looting and vandalism, warning that those responsible would face legal consequences.

What began as demonstrations over rising living costs soon escalated into widespread unrest, leaving retailers dealing with damaged stores and disrupted business.

Alef Aeronautics just took a cheeky dig at Tesla after Elon Musk showcased the new Roadster’s flying capabilities.

The startup released a video of its own flying car soaring over a Tesla Roadster, with CEO Jim Dukhovny welcoming Tesla to the flying car race and pointing out that Alef has been working on the technology for 11 years.

The stunt also marked the company’s 1,000th logged flight.

#MarketingMentor

France is taking a stand against ultra-fast fashion by targeting influencer promotions, including hauls, discount codes and sponsored try-ons.

From January 2027, influencers promoting fashion brands covered by the ban could face hefty fines. However, critics argue that the law could leave several familiar European fashion brands untouched. 

As fashion trends get faster, it’s worth asking ourselves how much of what we buy do we actually need?
 
#MarketingMentor

Jüsto, a Mexican supermarket chain, turned plastic pollution into an underwater world through a striking print campaign.

Plastic bags became jellyfish, bottles took the shape of coral, and wrappers looked like schools of fish.

The visuals blurred the line between marine life and the plastic threatening it. Sometimes, the most powerful way to highlight a problem is to show us what it could look like.

Does this kind of creative approach make the message more powerful?

Brand: Ju‌sto (@justomx)
Agency: The Prime (@theprimemx)

Jio has grown beyond telecom into a wider digital business spanning entertainment, cloud and digital services, and now it is preparing for its IPO. 

Reported institutional interest worth ₹2.5 lakh crore has put the upcoming offering in the spotlight even before it opens.

With bidding scheduled for October 21–23 and a proposed price band of ₹1,065–₹1,119 per share, investors will have an opportunity to own Jio Platforms shares directly. 

Do you think Jio’s entry into the stock market could change how investors look at India’s digital businesses?

Here's how brands are reacting to Tesla flying car launch 👀

#MarketingMentor

Akash Ambani outlines Jio’s ambition to take Indian technology global, with big bets on AI, 6G and digital services.

#MarketingMentor
KFC dumps Pepsi after 40 year long partnership!

Jio Platforms is gearing up for its IPO, marking a major milestone for Reliance’s digital business. 

The offering includes a reservation of shares worth up to ₹2,500 crore for eligible Reliance Industries shareholders and ₹500 crore for eligible employees. With the IPO scheduled to open on October 21 and close on October 23, the listing is one to watch. 

As more familiar businesses enter the stock market, which companies do you think could be next?

This is brilliant 👏

Apple’s $1,999 iPhone Duo sold out within minutes of pre-orders opening

New orders are already pushed to January 2027.

جامعة MSA تهنئ طلاب كلية التكنولوجيا الحيوية على إنجازهم المتميز! 🏆🌱

نجحت فرق من طلاب كلية التكنولوجيا الحيوية في حصد المركز الأول مناصفةً خلال مشاركتهم في هاكاثون «خليها وجدّدها 2026: بناء مستقبل مصر الأخضر»، الذي نظمته مؤسسة نهضة المحروسة، بمشاركة طلاب من تخصصات الهندسة وعلوم الحاسب من جامعات مختلفة.

#MSA #MSAUniversity #MSA_BIO #MSABIO_Achievements #MSABIO_Competitions

محمود بلاش، أيمن نجم، عمران صلاح، أنس عبدالله، وعبدالرحمن سالم يحصدون المركز الثاني في هاكاثون الذكاء الاصطناعي للتعليم 2026! 🏆

تهنئ جامعة (MSA) طلاب كلية الهندسة قسم نظم الحاسبات لحصول مشروعهم المبتكر Shafahi (شفهي)، على المركز الثاني وجائزة قدرها 60,000 جنيه مصري. 

يقدم مشروع شفهي حلًا مبتكرًا لتقييم مدى فهم الطلاب للأكواد البرمجية التي يكتبونها، من خلال تجربة تقييم شفهية مدعومة بالذكاء الاصطناعي، تتيح للطلاب شرح منهجية تفكيرهم والإجابة عن أسئلة تفاعلية حول أكوادهم باللغتين العربية والإنجليزية. 

ويعكس ذلك قدرة طلاب MSA على توظيف الذكاء الاصطناعي والتكنولوجيا في تطوير حلول مبتكرة تخدم مستقبل التعليم، إلى جانب ما يتمتعون به من إبداع وروح ابتكارية وقدرة على المنافسة والتميز. 

للاطلاع على الخبر بالموقع الرسمي للجامعة:
msa.edu.eg

MSA Engineering students secured 2nd place in the Gen AI for Education Hackathon 2026 with their innovative project, Shafahi, Their AI-powered solution focuses on assessing students’ understanding of the code they write through interactive oral assessment. 

#MSA #MSAUniversity #MSA_ENG #MSAENG_Achievements #MSAENG_Competitions

تنويه هام وعاجل من جامعة أكتوبر للعلوم الحديثة والآداب - MSA.

لوحظ في الآونة الأخيرة انتشار عدد من الصفحات والحسابات على مواقع التواصل الإجتماعي تحمل اسم جامعة MSA وتستخدم شعارها وهويتها البصرية بشكل غير قانوني، وتقوم بنشر معلومات مضللة وغير دقيقة.

وعليه، تؤكد إدارة الجامعة على الآتي:

1. أن هذه الصفحات ، ومنها ما هو موضح في هذا المنشور ، هي صفحات وهمية وغير رسمية، ولا تمت لجامعة MSA بأي صلة، ولا تعبر عنها،،وفي حال سبق لكم الانضمام إلى أي منها، يُرجى مغادرتها فورًا والإبلاغ عنها عبر المنصات المختلفة باعتبارها محتوى مزعجًا أوكاذبًا (Spam).

2. أن الجامعة تخلي مسؤوليتها الكاملة عن أي محتوى أو معلومات أو إعلانات يتم نشرها من خلال تلك الصفحات.

3. أن الجامعة ستتخذ كافة الإجراءات القانونية اللازمة تجاه القائمين على هذه الصفحات لانتحالهم صفة الجامعة ونشر معلومات وتنويهات مضلله.

ونهيب بجميع أبنائنا الطلاب وأولياء الأمور الكرام، عدم التعامل أو التفاعل مع هذه الصفحات، وعدم مشاركة أي بيانات شخصية من خلالها، والاعتماد فقط على المصادر الرسمية الموثقة للجامعة.

#MSAUniversity

The Faculty of Mass Communication at MSA University hosted Mr. Fady Ibrahim, award-winning Radio 9090 presenter and professional voice-over artist, for an engaging session with fourth-year students enrolled in Podcast and Vodcast.

The session explored the evolving world of broadcasting and digital content production, followed by a practical workshop at MSA’s Podcast Studios, giving students the opportunity to connect academic learning with real-world professional experience, under the coordination and supervision of Dr. Ghada Abaido and Mr. Mohamed Awes. 🎧🎬

شهدت كلية الإعلام بجامعة MSAيومًا مميزًا لدعم المبادرة المجتمعية «معًا يوم بلا شاشات»، بمشاركة أ.د. منى الحديدي، أستاذ الإذاعة والتلفزيون بكلية الإعلام جامعة القاهرة وعضو المجلس الأعلى لتنظيم الإعلام وصاحبة فكرة ومؤسسة المبادرة، والأستاذ أحمد عبد العليم قاسم، المخرج والكاتب ومدير عام السياحة والمنوعات بقناة Nile TV.

Egyptian President Abdel Fattah El-Sisi has confirmed that his presidency will end in 2030, describing the decision as final and not open for discussion.

Speaking on Saturday during a graduation ceremony at the Egyptian Military Academy in the New Administrative Capital, El-Sisi reaffirmed that Egypt’s Constitution would remain unchanged.

He also emphasized the importance of preparing qualified national leaders to take on future responsibilities, pledging to leave the country with capable individuals ready to lead.

Not every familiar face made it to El Gouna this year.

From festival regulars to celebrities we’ve seen on the red carpet in previous editions, a number of stars were noticeably absent from this year’s El Gouna Film Festival.

Here’s a look at some of the faces we missed seeing by the Red Sea.

Egypt and Al Ahly goalkeeper Mostafa Shobeir, known as Oufa, has officially joined Adidas Arabia as its newest brand ambassador.

The 26-year-old marks the partnership with a new campaign featuring a retro-inspired Adidas Originals look, swapping his goalkeeper gloves for a stylish off-pitch appearance.

Essam Omar teams up once again with the National Bank of Egypt (NBE) for a new advertising campaign.

The collaboration follows their previous campaign, which brought a creative approach to raising awareness about banking fraud and protecting personal information.

A glimpse into Armani Beauty’s exclusive event at the 9th edition of El Gouna Film Festival.

As the festival’s Official Beauty Sponsor, Armani Beauty brought together stars and personalities from the film and creative industries for an intimate celebration of beauty and cinema.

Elyanna is opening a new musical chapter with a cross-cultural collaboration.

The Palestinian-Chilean artist shared behind-the-scenes footage from recording sessions in Doha with Algerian Tuareg band Imarhan, known for blending desert rock with traditional Saharan sounds. The collaboration is part of the creative journey behind her upcoming album “Ghazali.”

The project sees Elyanna explore sounds and influences gathered through her travels, bringing different musical cultures into the world of her next album.

Marwan Pablo and acclaimed composer Hesham Nazih have released their new song “3ayesh” as part of Red Bull Mazzika Salonat.

The collaboration brings together Pablo’s signature rap and trap style with Nazih’s cinematic sound, known for his work on “The Blue Elephant” and the Pharaohs’ Golden Parade.

Created in just six hours during the ninth episode of the show's seventh season, the track reflects the project's concept of bringing artists from different musical backgrounds together to create original music from scratch.

“3ayesh” is now available to stream.

Ramy Sabry is marking two decades of music with one special night.

The Egyptian singer will take the stage at El Arena on November 6 for “20 Years of Ramy Sabry,” a concert celebrating the songs, memories and milestones that have shaped his career since the beginning.

The show is set to revisit some of the biggest tracks from across his 20-year journey, turning the night into a full celebration with his fans.

The red carpet at the 9th edition of El Gouna Film Festival brought together some of the biggest stars, showcasing glamorous looks and standout fashion moments.

From elegant gowns to bold statement pieces, celebrities turned heads at the opening ceremony, adding a touch of glamour to the celebration of cinema.

Which look is your favorite?

القشرة بتقع وبتطلع طرية؟ المشكلة مش في الخلطة ولا في نوع الدقيق.

السر إن المطاعم بتقلي الفراخ مرتين مش مرة:
🔸 القلية الأولى على نار هادية (حوالي 165 درجة) لحد ما الفرخة تستوي تماماً من جوه — لازم تستوي بالكامل في الخطوة دي.
🔸 ريّحها على شبكة 5 لـ 10 دقايق. البخار المحبوس بيهرب بدل ما يطرّي القشرة من جوه.
🔸 القلية التانية على نار عالية (حوالي 190 درجة) دقيقتين بس. دي للقرمشة فقط.

نصيحة زيادة: زوّدي كورن فلاور في الخلطة — بيدي قرمشة بتفضل صامدة بعد ما تخرج من الزيت.

latestIgtvVideos.caption:
Dear friends, I would like to share this showreel that includes small parts of the tvseries that I participated in.

My way in Egyptian cinematography started in 2018 by a beautiful chance. 
@amrmsalama chose me to act in his tvseries “Taye’e” with incredible @amryoussefofficial as a main character.

Then I played a role of a foreign singer in the tvshow called “A Million pound idea”, where I met amazing actors @aliirabee1989 and @karimafifi1☺️ and of course dear to my heart @rashad_roshdy!

2021 became a real magic for me. I got my first role in Arabic language in “Qasr El Nil” tvseries! With awesome @dinaelsherbinyy

And of course!!! 
Newton’s cradle!!! 
That role of a devil nurse (this is how some of the people started to call me afterwards 🤣) but, as I think, my character was a real sweetheart☺️😅
So much admiration and appreciation to @tamermo7sen who believed in me! 
@monazakiofficial  you always support me so much! And I’m  so glad our paths crossed again❤️

Now I’m participating in new projects that I would be extremely happy to share with you soon☺️❤️ ISA! 

——

Ребята, я сделала небольшой шоурил с кусочками из сериалов, в которых снималась в Египте. 
Очень хочу, чтобы Вы посмотрели❤️ 

Дальше-БОЛЬШЕ. 
Дорогу осилит идущий…
И так далее🤣
Люблю всех!
Очень скоро расскажу о своих новых проектах!

وجبة سريعة، خفيفة، ومليانة بروتين✔️

قطع تونة متماسكة صحية ولذيذة ، طعم غني، ومثالي في جميع الأوقات 👌♥️

فطر شيري المقطع🍄‍🟫 
يعطيك النكهة الغنية والقوام المميز لكل وصفاتك المفضلة 👌
بدون تعب التقطيع والتجهيز✔️

لأن بشرتك تستحق الأفضل دائماً، وفرنا لكِ كريم سريع الامتصاص (Neutrogena Deep Moisture Comfort Balm)، 
المصمم خصيصاً ليمنحك ترطيباً فائقاً يدوم طويلاً ويحافظ على نعومة بشرتك بكل راحة✔️👌

ميني بسكويت سبايسي بايتس (Spicey Bites) المقرمش بنكهاته الغنية، الخيار الأول لكل أوقات القرمشة والنقنقة✔️😍

اطلبوها من ديريال 🛒♥️

القسم اللي ما بتستغنى عنه ست البيت 👌
أصناف متعددة ،، جودة عالية والأسعار ما اتغيرت ✔️

في انتظاركم داخل أفضل وجهة للتسوق 🛒♥️

وداعاً للدهون المستعصية ووقت الجلي الطويل 👌
مع سائل جلي الصحون ABC، نقطة واحدة بسيطة تعطي رغوة كثيفة وقوة تنظيف جبارة تقضي على أصعب الدهون بلمسة واحدة✔️

اختار سناكك الصح لليوم✔️✅
 واستمتع بالطعم التركي الأصيل الغني بالبندق بالحليب👌

حضرو قهوتكم واستمتعوا بطعم القهوة مع الشوكولا♥️🫰

عطر الطبيعة وسر النكهة الأصلية يكتملان معاً في منتجاتك المفضلة من صابحة 👌🌸🍊
نوفر لكِ  ثنائي النقاء والانتعاش من منتجات صامحة الفاخرة: 
 ماء الورد : نقاء يلامس حواسُك ويمنح روتينك اليومي وعنايتك لمسة من الانتعاش الطبيعي الساحر✔️. 
 ماء الزهر ؛ العبق الأصيل والسر خلف أزكى الحلويات والنكهات الشرقية التي تملأ مطبخك دفئاً وعبيراً لا يُقاوم✔️

طعم البندق الغني والشوكولاتة الناعمة من ساريل (Sarelle) بتضمنلك ساندويشة إفطار بيحبوها الكبار والصغار😍

Run Through September!🏃🏻🏃🏻‍♀️

Your Wadi Ibex calendar is here! Join us throughout September for our weekly trail adventures at Wadi Degla Protectorate, Zahraa Maadi Entrance, at 6:00 AM.

Whether you’re running or hiking, there’s a place for you on the trail. We’ll have different running groups for all levels, with varying distances and speeds

No registration needed, just come energized, hydrated, and ready to move.

See you on the trail!🗻

#trailrunninglife #runnerscommunity #wadiibex #ultraibex #trailrunners

📍 Wadi Degla Protectorate, Zahraa Maadi entrance

Different running groups will be available for all levels, with different distances and speeds.

No registration needed, just come energized, hydrated, and ready to move!

#wadiibex #satutrail #trailrunning #runnerscommunity

LET'S GIVE BACK TO NATURE 🌿 

Join us for the largest community clean-up day at Wadi Degla Protectorate on Saturday October 24 at 9 AM. Together, we will help protect its natural beauty, keep its trails cleaner, and leave the place better than we found it. Wadi Degla is more than just a place to run, hike, and escape the city. 

✨ Everyone is welcome
🌱 Free to join the event
🤝 Every helping hand makes a difference

Come spend a purposeful morning outdoors, meet like-minded people, and be part of something that genuinely makes a positive impact 💚

Clean-up starts at 9 AM. Please arrive early to park and find the start line.

Sign Up: https://bit.ly/4dCEA7M

وادي دجلة مش مجرد مكان بنجري فيه، أو نمشي فيه، أو نهرب شوية من دوشة وزحمة القاهرة. وادي دجلة مكان طبيعي بتاعنا كلنا، بنستمتع بيه وبنقضي فيه وقت حلو. سواء بتروح تخيّم، تعمل بيكنيك، تتمشى، أو تستمتع بالطبيعة… دلوقتي جه دورنا نرد له الجميل 💚
انضموا لينا في أكبر يوم تنظيف مجتمعي في محمية وادي دجلة. مع بعض هنساعد نحافظ على جمال الوادي وطبيعته، ونخلّي طرقه ومساراته أنضف، ونسيب المكان أحسن ما لقيناه.
✨ الكل مرحب بيه
🌱 المشاركة مجانًا
🤝 كل إيد بتساعد بتفرق
تعالوا نقضي صباح له معنى وسط الطبيعة، نتعرف على ناس عندها نفس الاهتمام، ونشارك سوا في حاجة حلوة ليها تأثير إيجابي حقيقي 💚
التنظيف هيبدأ الساعة ٩ الصبح. ياريت تيجوا بدري علشان تلحقوا تركنوا وتوصلوا لنقطة البداية في معادكم

A Personal Life Update.....

Not every chapter in life ends the way we imagined, and not every journey is meant to continue along the same path.

After sharing years of memories, experiences, and building a family together, Dashna and I have separated (since January) and are now moving forward on different paths.

This hasn't been an easy chapter, but out of respect for our history, our children, and the life we once shared, I choose to focus on the good memories, the lessons learned, and the future ahead.

My priority remains being the best father I can be to my children, finding peace, and embracing what life has in store for me.

Some chapters close, but the story doesn't end. Sometimes, it's simply the beginning of a new one 📖

Lastly, I want to express my heartfelt gratitude to those who have stood by me, checked in on me, and offered their unwavering support throughout this difficult chapter. Your kindness, encouragement, and friendship have meant more to me than words can express. Sometimes, it's during life's toughest moments that we truly discover the value of the people around us.....

ضمن فعاليات القمة السنوية للإعلام والصحة العامة، تناولت الحلقة النقاشية الثانية ملف الصحة النفسية والدعم المجتمعي، مسلطةً الضوء على أهمية الوعي بالصحة النفسية، ودور المجتمع في تقديم الدعم، وتعزيز بيئة أكثر تفهمًا واحتواءً لاحتياجات أفراده.
وشاركت في الحلقة:
د/ شيماء عادل
د/ ندى دويدار
د/ نيفين حجازي
د/ أماني الطوخي
ادارت الجلسة: د.زهراء أبراهيم

في حوار جمع بين خبرات ورؤى متعددة حول الصحة النفسية، وأهمية تكامل الجهود الفردية والمجتمعية في بناء مجتمع أكثر وعيًا ودعمًا.
لأن الصحة النفسية جزءٌ أساسي من صحة المجتمع.

التغيير لا يحتاج دائمًا إلى أن يكون كبيرًا… أحيانًا يبدأ بشخص واحد.
خلال فعاليات القمة السنوية للإعلام والصحة العامة، شاركت الفنانة والإعلامية سالي حماد بكلمة ألقت فيها الضوء على قوة التغيير البسيط، وأهمية أن نبدأ بأنفسنا وبمن حولنا.
وتناولت أيضًا الدور المؤثر للإعلام في نشر الوعي الصحي، وتقديم الرسائل التي تشجع الناس على اتخاذ خطوات إيجابية، وتحويل المعلومة من مجرد كلام يُسمع إلى وعي يُترجم إلى سلوك.
فالتغيير يبدأ بخطوة… وربما تبدأ خطوتك اليوم بشخص واحد.

حين تتطور التكنولوجيا… تتغير ملامح الرعاية الصحية.

خلال فعاليات القمة السنوية للإعلام والصحة العامة، 

تحدث د/ أيمن أمين - CEO Zemam Cooperation 

عن دور التكنولوجيا في القطاع الصحي، والتطورات الحديثة التي تشهدها المنظومة، وكيف يمكن التعامل معها والاستفادة منها بما يواكب احتياجات المستقبل.

وتناول الحديث أهمية مواكبة التطور التكنولوجي، وفهم الأدوات والتقنيات الحديثة، إلى جانب الوعي بكيفية توظيفها بصورة فعّالة ومسؤولة بما يدعم تطوير الخدمات الصحية وتحسين تجربة المرضى.

فالتكنولوجيا لم تعد عنصرًا منفصلًا عن المنظومة الصحية، بل أصبحت جزءًا أساسيًا من تطورها ومستقبلها.

من التطور إلى التطبيق… تبدأ ملامح مستقبلٍ أكثر ابتكارًا للصحة.

الحلقة النقاشية الأولى | التغذية في مصر

ضمن فعاليات القمة السنوية للإعلام والصحة العامة، تناولت أولى الحلقات النقاشية ملف التغذية في مصر، مسلطةً الضوء على أهمية الوعي الغذائي ودوره في دعم صحة المجتمع، إلى جانب أبرز القضايا والتحديات المرتبطة بالتغذية.

شارك في الحلقة:
د/ سلمى أبو مسلم الجمال
د/ رانيا يحيى
د/ ريهام محمد
د/ نيفين فهمي

وأدارت الجلسة الإعلامية ندى إمام، في حوار جمع بين خبرات ورؤى متعددة حول أحد الملفات الأساسية في مجال الصحة العامة.

نقاشٌ يثري الوعي… ورؤى تساهم في صناعة مجتمع أكثر صحة.

خلال فعاليات القمة السنوية للإعلام والصحة العامة، تحدّث 
د/ عبدالرحمن الذهبي - شريك مؤسس MedGate

عن MedGate ورؤيتها والدور الذي تسعى إلى القيام به في دعم الشباب ومساعدتهم على توظيف معارفهم ومهاراتهم بما يتناسب مع احتياجات القطاع الصحي وسوق العمل.

كما أتاح حديثه للحضور فرصة للتعرّف بشكل أعمق على MedGate، ومساراتها المختلفة، وكيف تسعى إلى بناء جسور بين ما يمتلكه الشباب من معرفة وقدرات، وما يحتاجه الواقع المهني والمنظومة الصحية.

لأن المعرفة وحدها ليست دائمًا كافية، ولأن الإمكانيات تحتاج إلى مساحة وفرصة لتتحول إلى أثر.

⁨	التغيير يبدأ حين يدرك الشباب أن لهم دورًا فيه.

خلال فعاليات القمة السنوية للإعلام والصحة العامة، تحدثت 
د/ يمنى طارق - مسؤل إدارة المشاريع MedGate 

عن دور الشباب في رفع الوعي المجتمعي، والمساهمة في النهوض بالمجال الصحي، مؤكدةً أن الشباب ليسوا مجرد جزء من المستقبل، بل عنصر فاعل في صناعة التغيير منذ اليوم.

فصناعة مجتمع أكثر وعيًا صحيًا لا تعتمد على المؤسسات وحدها، بل تبدأ أيضًا من أفراد يمتلكون المعرفة، ويؤمنون بمسؤوليتهم، ويختارون أن يكونوا جزءًا من الحل.⁩

سعدنا بمشاركة أ/ جاسر عبدالفتاح، مدير العلاقات الحكومية والشراكات الاستراتيجية بشركة ماجنوم السعودية – برج فوربس العالمي
ضمن فعاليات القمة السنوية للإعلام والصحة العامة.

وخلال حديثه، شارك الحضور جانبًا من قصصه وتجربته عبر محطات العمل المختلفة، مستعرضًا بعض الدروس التي شكّلت مسيرته المهنية، ومقدمًا مجموعة من النصائح المهنية للشباب حول بناء مسارهم والاستفادة من تجاربهم في بداية رحلتهم العملية.

جاءت مشاركته لتضيف جانبًا عمليًا إلى الحوار، وتمنح الشباب مساحة للاستماع إلى تجربة مهنية حقيقية، والتعرّف على رؤى ونصائح يمكن أن تساعدهم في خطواتهم القادمة.

كل التقدير لأ/ جاسر عبدالفتاح، ولمشاركته خبرته ورؤيته مع شباب القمة.

حين تلتقي الخبرة بالوعي… يتسع أثر الصحة.
سعدنا بمشاركة د/ هند الطيبي
 أستاذ اقتصاد الصحة والصيدلة الجينية، ومستشار اقتصاد الصحة والدواء بالمجلس الأعلى للمستشفيات الجامعية عضو لجنة الأخلاقيات ,بمستشفى جوستاف روسي الدولية  بمصر

ضمن فعاليات القمة السنوية للإعلام والصحة العامة، بما تمتلكه من خبرة في مجالات اقتصاد الصحة والصيدلة الجينية، وإسهاماتها في دعم الوعي الصحي وتعزيز أهمية التأثير على مختلف الأصعدة داخل القطاع الصحي.

ويأتي حضورها امتدادًا لدورها في تسليط الضوء على قضايا الصحة، وتعزيز الوعي بها، والتأكيد على أهمية التكامل بين المعرفة والخبرة والتأثير المجتمعي في بناء منظومة صحية أكثر وعيًا واستدامة.

كل التقدير لد. هند الطيبي، ولمشاركتها في إثراء الحوار حول قضايا الصحة العامة في مصر.

من القمة… بدأت الخطوة الأولى نحو «قادة الصحة».

كان إطلاق برنامج «قادة الصحة» أحد أبرز محطات القمة السنوية للإعلام والصحة العامة، من خلال كلمة جمعت
 د/ أحمد صالح 
د/ عبدالله منعم
الشركاء المؤسسين لميدجيت

للحديث عن رؤية البرنامج، وأهدافه، والدور الذي يسعى إلى إحداثه في مستقبل القطاع الصحي.

ينطلق البرنامج من إدراكٍ واضح لفجوةٍ قائمة بين المعرفة الأكاديمية التي يكتسبها الطلاب خلال سنوات الدراسة، وبين المهارات والقدرات التي يتطلبها الواقع العملي والمهني داخل المنظومة الصحية.

ومن هنا، يأتي «قادة الصحة» كبرنامج تدريبي يمتد على مدار خمسة أشهر، ويجمع طلابًا من مختلف التخصصات الصحية في خمس جامعات، بهدف تأهيلهم بصورة أكثر شمولًا، وربط ما يتعلمونه أكاديميًا بالمهارات التي يحتاجون إليها في واقعهم المهني.
ويتناول البرنامج عددًا من المحاور الأساسية، من بينها أساسيات التواصل، والأخلاقيات المهنية، والمسؤولية القانونية، وسلامة المرضى، إلى جانب بناء مجموعة من المهارات التي تساعد المشاركين على التعامل مع التحديات الصحية بصورة أكثر وعيًا واحترافية.

ومع إطلاق «قادة الصحة»، تتحول مناقشة الفجوة بين التعليم والواقع إلى خطوة عملية نحو إعداد جيل أكثر جاهزية للمشاركة في تطوير المنظومة الصحية وصناعة أثر مستدام داخل المجتمع.

نُقدّر من صنعوا للحوار قيمته.

في ختام الجلسة الأولى من القمة السنوية للإعلام والصحة العامة، احتفينا بالخبرات التي شاركتنا رؤاها وفتحت نقاشًا أعمق حول مستقبل الصحة العامة في مصر.

Some places are worth waiting for, and in 2027, Cred begins handing over the keys. 🌿

Imagine coming home to tree-lined avenues, landscaped gardens, and water views. That’s Ever East, in New Cairo’s Sixth Settlement. A central waterway runs through the community, with pocket parks for morning walks and a clubhouse where neighbours can meet and unwind. Offices, clinics and shops are within walking distance, keeping everyday essentials close to home.

Over on the 26th of July Corridor, right next to Mall of Arabia, Ever West is a place of two halves: a lively business district with commercial and medical spaces, and a calm residential corner of fully finished homes overlooking gardens and water. With an international clubhouse operator joining the community, there’s always something happening close to home. 🌳

Two communities, one belief: nature and convenience belong in everyday life. ✨

🎬 استعاد الفنان أحمد داود ذكرياته مع المخرج الراحل محمد خان خلال تعاونهما في فيلم «قبل زحمة الصيف»، آخر أعماله السينمائية، مؤكدًا أن التجربة كانت استثنائية فنيًا وإنسانيًا، وذلك خلال جلسة «رجال محمد خان: أبطال خارج المألوف» بمهرجان الجونة السينمائي في دورته التاسعة.

وكشف داود أن أبرز الدروس التي تعلمها من المخرج الراحل كانت عدم التوقف طويلًا عند النجاح أو الفشل، مستشهدًا بعبارته الشهيرة «اللي بعده»، التي أصبحت فلسفة يطبقها في حياته ومشواره الفني.

🌧️ كما روى كواليس مشهد المطر، الذي تأثر خلاله محمد خان بسقوط الأمطار الطبيعية، وظل يردد «ثانكس جاد»، مؤكدًا أنه يتمنى ظهور مخرجين يمتلكون روح التجربة والخصوصية السينمائية التي ميزت محمد خان وعاطف الطيب.

وقال وزير الشؤون الاقتصادية التايواني، كونغ مينغ شين، إن الحكومة تخطط لإضافة أشباه الموصلات المتقدمة وخوادم الذكاء الاصطناعي إلى قائمة السلع الخاضعة للرقابة، دون تحديد موعد لتطبيق الإجراءات.

وتأتي الخطوة في ظل المنافسة التكنولوجية بين الولايات المتحدة والصين، ومساعي واشنطن للحد من وصول الشركات الصينية إلى الرقائق المتقدمة، بالتزامن مع تعزيز التعاون الصناعي والتكنولوجي بين تايوان والولايات المتحدة.

items.biography: Egypt’s tastiest food culture magazine.

latestPosts.caption:
@SceneEats: For years, Suzanne Zeidy and Rawah Badrawi had to argue that Egyptian food could fill a book. At Cairo Food Week, their book filled a museum.

Presented at the Grand Egyptian Museum, Tables of Egypt transforms ‘Egypt: Recipes and Stories from an Ancient Land’ into an immersive journey through the five landscapes that structure the 420-page volume: the Sea, Desert, River, Mountain and Cairo. A WHEN WE EAT concept powered by MARAKEZ, the exhibition brings to life years of travel through 14 Egyptian cities and towns, where the authors documented more than 150 recipes alongside the people, histories and places that sustained them.

Creatively developed by Hana Shash and designed by Ramzi Makram-Ebeid, five circular capsules pair Jonathan Gregson’s photographs - printed on papyrus - with contemporary artistic interpretations. Mohamed Mahdy, supported by Mai Eldib, responds to the Sea; Shahira Fahmy interprets the Desert and Cairo; Emma James follows the River; and Louis Barthélemy approaches the Mountain, with Ghada Dwaik shaping the exhibition through light.

For the opening, The Cookery Co. translated the five landscapes into canapés, while FR Studio’s The Table carried them into distinct tablescapes and Flower Power extended them through botanical installations. The book’s journey - from land to kitchen to page - was briefly reversed, allowing visitors to travel from page to landscape and, finally, towards something they could eat.

The result is both exhibition and homecoming - years of recipes, fieldwork and inherited knowledge returned to Egypt in physical form. Publishers once doubted that Egyptian cuisine could sustain a major book. Tables of Egypt reveals a country too expansive to remain inside one.

Tables of Egypt opened with a private viewing on September 25th and is open to the public at the Grand Egyptian Museum on September 26th and 27th.

For the full feature on Tables of Egypt, head to www.SceneEats.com or download the #SceneNow app. 

📸/🎥 @SceneEats

@SceneEats: Before Mohamad Orfali became one of the region’s most decorated chefs, he was a teenager in Aleppo trying not to let his friends discover that he worked in a restaurant. The deception held until a waiter failed to turn up one evening and Orfali was sent into the dining room. Among the guests waiting to be served were, unfortunately, his friends. His chef gave him a choice - stop being ashamed of the work or find something else to do.

Orfali chose the kitchen. It proved consequential. He studied cooking, left Syria, worked across the region, became a familiar face on food television and eventually opened Orfali Bros in Dubai with his younger brothers, Wassim and Omar. The restaurant would go on to spend three consecutive years at No. 1 on MENA’s 50 Best Restaurants. Their latest proposition is Three Bros — though it was actually the brothers’ original game plan — and from August 20th to 25th, it is leaving Dubai for Moga on Egypt’s North Coast, closing the summer run of WHEN WE EAT at Ramla by MARAKEZ. The residency follows Tulum’s Arca, led by José Luis Hinostroza, and Kinoya, Dubai’s celebrated ramen house.

Three Bros makes considerably more sense once you know Orfali’s history. He trained in classical European cooking before discovering an awkward hole in his education at a conference in Seville, where a journalist asked him to explain the cuisine of his native Aleppo. Orfali couldn’t. The embarrassment prompted a deep study of the food he had grown up around, including the cooking of the grandmother he calls his “first school.”

What emerged was not a desire to preserve Syrian cooking behind glass. At Three Bros, Aleppo can happily share a table with Japan, Spain and France — and with the OB Cheeseburger, proof that an acclaimed chef can pursue a burger with the same seriousness afforded to haute cuisine.

Bookings are available through Moga.

For the full feature on Three Bros' North Coast takeover, head to www.SceneEats.com or download the #SceneNow app.

🎥 @SceneEats

@SceneEats: Executive Chef José Luis Hinostroza could have kept climbing the world's most predictable culinary ladder. Instead, he stayed in Tulum.

By then, he'd already cooked in some of modern gastronomy's biggest kitchens - Alinea, El Celler de Can Roca and Noma, where he later joined the team behind its celebrated Mexico residency. But rather than treating the Yucatán Peninsula as another stamp on his passport, he built something there. The jungle, the Caribbean coastline, hardwood fire and a network of local fishermen, growers and foragers became the framework for Arca, a restaurant that cooks from where it is rather than what it's expected to be. That approach has earned it the No. 22 spot on Latin America's 50 Best Restaurants 2025 - and the kind of reputation that has people planning entire trips around a reservation.

From July 29 to August 2, that reservation is on Egypt's North Coast.

For one week only, Hinostroza is recreating Arca at @when_we_eat_ at @ramlabymarakez, hosted at @mogabyramla, bringing the restaurant's fire-led cooking to the Mediterranean. Think less guest chef, more temporary relocation, as one of Latin America's defining restaurants settles into a different landscape, works with new ingredients and cooks for a new audience.

Arca opens the second season of @when_we_eat_ at @ramlabymarakez, which this summer expands into Egypt's first global restaurant residency programme. Created by @flavor_republic, the team behind Cairo Food Week, the series continues with Kinoya from August 11–15 before concluding with Three Bros from August 20–25, turning Moga into a seasonal home for three internationally acclaimed restaurants. Reservations are available directly through @mogabyramla

For the full feature on Arca's Mediterranean take over, head to www.SceneEats.com or download the #SceneNow app.

🎥 @SceneEats

@SceneEats: What happens when you bring Egypt’s coffee lovers, roasters and baristas under one roof? Two days of coffee-fuelled competitions, workshops, tastings and enough caffeine to keep the conversation going. That was the idea behind the second edition of Egypt Coffee Festival, which wrapped up at Kamelizer Spaces in District 5 on October 16th and 17th.

Organised by Kamelizer Spaces, this year’s festival took its theme, Common Grounds, quite literally, creating a meeting point for the people shaping Egypt’s growing specialty coffee scene. From established roasters and coffee brands to home-brewing enthusiasts and curious newcomers, the two-day event brought together different sides of the industry, with plenty to do beyond ordering another cup.

Across six themed areas, visitors could explore coffee culture from several angles, whether that meant discovering new roasters, getting hands-on with brewing techniques or watching competitors put their skills to the test. The Roaster Village featured names including Mestila, La Cimbali and Brown Nose, giving attendees the chance to discover different brands and sample what they had brewing.

Naturally, a coffee festival would not be complete without a little friendly competition. The Home Barista Challenge saw creators and influencers go head-to-head to make the best flat white, putting their coffee-making skills to the test. Meanwhile, the Cross the Rush Challenge brought its own competitive energy, with participants racing to break the ice first for a chance to win giveaways.

With its second edition now wrapped, Egypt Coffee Festival has given the local coffee scene another opportunity to connect over the drink that brings everyone back to the table.

For more snackable content from across Egypt, head to www.SceneEats.com (link in bio) or download the SceneNow app.

🎥 @SceneEats
🎤 Nayera Nabil

@SceneEats #EatsAd: A familiar favourite is getting a little more comfortable. Crave has reopened its Waterway branch after a renovation that puts the focus on making diners feel more at home, whether they're dropping in for a quick meal or settling in for a longer catch-up over food.

The idea is simple enough: a good meal deserves a setting you actually want to spend time in. With its Waterway branch now refreshed and ready to roll, Crave is looking beyond what's on the plate to the experience of dining out itself, giving the space a new lease on life while keeping the focus on what brings people back in the first place.

And Waterway is only the beginning. The renovation is part of a wider campaign to bring the same attention to comfort across Crave's branches, with the aim of making the experience feel just as inviting wherever diners choose to visit. It's an ongoing effort to rethink the spaces around the table, from the first bite to the point when nobody is quite ready to leave yet.

For those who already have their Crave favourites, Waterway is ready to welcome them back. The familiar address is still there, but with a new setting that makes sitting down for a meal all the better.

@SceneEats: Where to Find the Best Sandos in Egypt - A SceneEats Guide 

The Japanese sando has always understood something important about sandwiches: simplicity only works when every part earns its place. Soft shokupan, carefully chosen fillings, and just enough sauce to hold everything together have made the format a staple of Japanese cafés and convenience stores, where sandos can range from crisp cutlets to egg salad and far more inventive combinations.

That same flexibility is exactly why the sando has travelled so well. Across Egypt, restaurants are now taking the format in different directions, playing with fillings and sauces while keeping that soft-bread foundation at the centre. Some stay close to the Japanese original, while others treat the sando as a starting point for something more indulgent. Either way, these are the spots doing them especially well.

For the full guide, head to www.SceneEats.com or download the #SceneNow app (available on iOS and Android).

🖊️ Farah Helmy

@SceneEats #EatsAd: What happens when dinner comes without the usual visual cues? Crave is teaming up with Dialogue in the Dark for another edition of Crave in the Dark, an experience that asks diners to put their eyes out of the equation and let their other senses take over.

Held entirely in the dark, the experience invites guests to enjoy mystery meals without knowing what’s on their plates. Every bite becomes a small discovery, challenging diners to reconsider how much they rely on sight to experience food.

The collaboration also carries a purpose beyond the dinner table. Dialogue in the Dark, a project of Egypt’s Al Nour Wal Amal Association, uses immersive experiences to challenge assumptions about visual impairment and encourage a more inclusive understanding of disability. By placing sighted participants in situations where they must rely on senses other than vision, the initiative invites them to reconsider everyday barriers and the capabilities of visually impaired people. The aim is to move beyond sympathy towards empathy, while advocating for a society that makes room for different ways of navigating the world. All profits from Crave in the Dark will go directly to Dialogue in the Dark, supporting its ongoing work.

Crave in the Dark returns on October 24th at Waterway at 5:30 PM, followed by another evening at Arkan on November 11th at 7:30 PM. Bookings are open via DM or by calling 01094773723.

Come hungry, leave your expectations at the door, and discover dinner without sight.

@SceneEats #SceneAD: Friday Brunch is back at Arola Brasserie at Giza Palace Hotel & Spa in West Cairo, bringing a familiar favourite back to the Friday routine. Every Friday from 1 to 5 PM, guests can settle in for an afternoon of Mediterranean flavours, leisurely dining and the kind of meal that makes the weekend feel officially underway.

But one thing is different, this time. With a new a la carte menu, the Mediterranean fusion restaurant is introducing to Friday Brunch a range of culinary creations devised by their resident Michelin-starred chef, Sergi Arola. 

What are these creations, you ask? Consider a delicate, pan-fried foie gras on Italina focaccia bread, a succulent duck magret with apple gastrique, and tender braised short ribs where the meat falls off the bone. Hear the sound of the dessert trolley as it wheels round and round, dispensing delicate macarons and handcrafted chocolate pralines onto guests. It's a family-friendly brunch, which means no one will judge if you bring your kids so you can gorge on the meals yourself. 

On Friday, October 16th, a special Friday Brunch will take place with Chef Sergi Arola himself, who, before bringing his signature patatas bravas to life at Arola Brasserie, earned two Michelin stars in Madrid. Chef Sergi Arola went on to build a career that carried him across Europe, Latin America and Asia before arriving on the west bank of Cairo, where brunch-ers will get to meet (and greet) him on Friday.

Friday Brunch at Arola Brasserie takes place every Friday from 1-5pm, starting at 1800 EGP per person. Guests can also opt for a local alcohol package for an additional EGP 900. Reservations can be made at 01040070925.

#EatsArchives: As the late 1980s and 1990s hit their stride, Bisco Misr had already secured its place in Egypt’s snack landscape, with Nice and Luxe becoming familiar faces at morning tea tables, in school lunchboxes and on seaside trips. A vintage advertisement for the biscuit company brings the two classics back into focus, alongside the old-school branding and unmistakable red lettering that once made Bisco Misr a fixture in Egyptian households.

Featuring the brand’s familiar red Arabic lettering and its slogan, the advertisement showcases two classic offerings: Nice coconut biscuits and Luxe, alongside the geometric-patterned tea biscuits associated with Arabisco. With their colourful wrappers, illustrated coconut and gold-toned packaging, the products offer a glimpse into an era when even a packet of biscuits had its own recognisable look.

في الثمانينات والتسعينات، كانت كلمة "بسكو مصر" هي العنوان الرسمي لأي قعدة شاي الصبح، أو لكنتين المدرسة، أو حتى قاعدة البحر في مصيف إسكندرية!
 
إعلان قديم لـ "بسكو مصر" بيرجعنا بالذاكرة لأيام البسكويت الكلاسيكي اللي اتربينا عليه؛ من "نايس" بطعم جوز الهند، لـ "لوكس" و"أرابيسكو" بتصميمه المميز، مع شعار "أصل الطعامة" والخط الأحمر الشهير اللي كان موجود في كل بيت مصري.

أغلفة ألوانها بسيطة، وطعم يرجعك لأيام زمان. قولنا إيه أكتر نوع بسكويت كنت بتحب تاخده معاك المدرسة أو تسقسقه في الشاي؟

@TheCairoZoom #ZoomAD: There is, as far as we know, no historical record of the Ancient Egyptians doing brunch. Which only makes us wonder why, because the Pyramids of Giza make a rather spectacular backdrop for one.

At the historic Marriott Mena House Cairo, a Saturday ritual takes place at 139 Pavilion from 1PM to 4PM, where the experience stretches comfortably into that hazy afternoon period that asks: is this brunch or lunch?

The answer, conveniently, is that it does not really matter. The menu covers a considerable amount of ground, moving from seafood, salads and cold mezze to carving stations, pasta, BBQ, Asian and Indian dishes, alongside Egyptian staples including koshary, molokhia, mombar and Egyptian dolma. Dessert follows with everything from lemon ricotta cheesecake and panna cotta to kunafa, baklava, basbousa and Om Ali.

But it’s the rhythm of the afternoon that gives it character. People linger. Another plate appears. Drinks are topped up. Entertainment in the background. The Pyramids remain exactly where they have always been.

United for Her, Stronger Together 🤍✨
